description: This file defines the KmsMaterialsProvider class which facilitates encryption and decryption of data using AWS KMS. It implements methods for managing materials descriptions, encrypting, and decrypting content encryption keys (CEKs) with a KMS client.

classes.name: KmsMaterialsProvider
classes.description: Provides support for encrypting and decrypting data using AWS KMS, specific to the legacy implementation of S3 encryption workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a specific KMS client and optional key ID.

methods.name: fromDecryptionEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a provider instance from a given encryption envelope by extracting materials description.

methods.name: getMaterialsDescription
methods.description: Returns the materials description, primarily the KMS key ID associated with this provider.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Returns the algorithm name used for key wrapping, which is 'kms' in this implementation.

methods.name: encryptCek
methods.description: Encrypts a content encryption key (CEK) using AWS KMS's Encrypt API, returning a base64-encoded ciphertext.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted CEK using AWS KMS's Decrypt API, returning the plaintext key.
